And the 2026 Matrix conference 🇸🇪 has come to an end (I know, I'm late)! Huge thanks to everyone who supported us this week, from the Matrix.org sponsors funding our transport and accommodation, our [opencollective](https://opencollective.com/continuwuity) sponsors for keeping us fed & watered during the conference, and everyone who attended and/or watched the recordings of our talks! Hope to see even more people in the Netherlands 🇳🇱 for the Matrix conference 2027!
